subject: Onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap & SKU split for ClearMap
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearmap.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@clearmap.io
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearMap onboarding materials + initial PO request

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick demo this week — ClearMap is excited to move forward. I've attached our completed onboarding form and the initial SKU list we plan to bill against (sku_mapping_clearMap_v2.csv). Procurement asked whether Redwood will issue a single PO for the initial commit or if you can break into two line items for core inference and premium support.

For planning, estimated first-month spend is $48,500; finance would like a clear spend cap and PO number in place before we kick off any usage. Can you confirm the PO issuance process and an expected PO # so we can reference it on our side?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Vendor Ops, ClearMap
elena.torres@clearmap.io
Attachments: ClearMap_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), sku_mapping_clearMap_v2.csv (csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearmap.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procure@clearmap.io
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearMap onboarding materials + initial PO request

Elena — thanks for the form and SKU list. Quick answers:
- We can issue a single PO with separate line items for "Core Inference" and "Premium Support."
- I will loop in Priyom (procurement ops) and Monica (finance) to confirm the provisional PO number and the canonical spend cap.

Priyom / Monica — can you provision a PO for ClearMap (estimate $48.5k first month) and confirm the spend cap we should put on the PO? Also, ClearMap has requested the PO # before they start consuming; ideally we provide a provisional PO and then finalize after contract countersign.

Elena — if you need the PO attached to a DocuSign envelope, include the link and we will attach the PDF.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearmap.io>, procure@clearmap.io
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ClearMap onboarding materials + initial PO request

Ben / Monica — provisioning notes from procurement ops:
- I've provisionally reserved PO #64218 for ClearMap. This is a provisional PO (will be finalized once the SOW is countersigned).
- Spend cap: set to $75,000 for the first 90 days to accommodate burst usage; recommended to avoid hard caps for pilot but we can gate at $75k.
- We will structure the PO as two line items:
  1) Core Inference (SKU group A) — estimated $40,000/mo
  2) Premium Support (SKU group B) — estimated $8,500/mo

Action items for Monica: please confirm ledger assignment (GL codes) and whether we need an additional billing contact on file for ClearMap.

Priyom
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearmap.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ClearMap onboarding materials + initial PO request

Thanks Priyom — PO #64218 works for procurement to reference. A quick issue: our procurement team noticed that the SKU mapping we originally sent collapses two distinct line items used by our internal chargeback (edge-infer vs. batch-embed). Can Redwood split the Core Inference line into two OBI line items so our finance team can route costs correctly? We attached an updated SKU file (sku_mapping_clearMap_v2.csv) with highlighted rows to split.

Also — is a hard spend cap required to trigger a stop, or can you implement a notification + soft-gate so we can approve increases? ClearMap prefers a soft-gate notification at 80% and a hard stop at 120% only if authorized.

If helpful, I can mark the exact rows to split and send back.

—Elena

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearmap.io>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 14:41:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: ClearMap onboarding materials + initial PO request

All — quick confirmation from finance after reviewing the updated SKU mapping:
- We will convert the Core Inference line into two line items on PO #64218:
  1) Edge Inference — SKU group A1 — amount $30,000 (monthly estimate)
  2) Batch Embedding — SKU group A2 — amount $10,000 (monthly estimate)
  3) Premium Support — SKU group B — amount $8,500
- Spend cap: we'll implement a soft-gate system: notifications at 80% usage of the $75k window (automated email to both finance and ClearMap procurement) and require explicit approval to enable any temporary increase beyond 100%. Hard stop will not be applied by default; if ClearMap requests a hard stop we'll set it up but it must be acknowledged in the SOW.
- Ledger assignment: GL 5120 for product (Edge + Batch), GL 7140 for support. Billing contact: billing@clearmap.io (please confirm).

Elena — please confirm billing@clearmap.io is the right billing email and confirm acceptance of the revised line item breakdown. Once you confirm, procurement will attach the finalized PO PDF and I will ask Ben to trigger DocuSign.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_PO_64218.pdf (pdf)
